author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all,

The proposal has been made to obsolete GO:0034045 phagophore assembly site membrane
see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29437

The term asserted, as a necessary and sufficient condition, that a membrane forms the bounding layer of the phagophore assembly site. That axiom has been removed (geneontology/go-ontology#32434); the class itself has no defensible referent and is proposed for obsoletion, replaced by the new term phagophore membrane (geneontology/go-ontology#32491). A second new term, ATG9-containing vesicle, has been created to hold the Atg9 vesicle annotations (geneontology/go-ontology#32500).

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here:
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1Td_VoNURpnoHfWs0bqwixDAcNNOK9I7uu4EN5LTfmbo

**110 direct annotations** with experimental or author-statement evidence: 62 EXP, 29 IDA, 17 NAS, 2 TAS.

Impacted groups:

ComplexPortal	27
MGI	1
Reactome	2
~TAIR	1~
UniProt	80
IntAct	2

A per-annotation triage with a proposed destination for each annotation, and the reasoning, is in the analysis posted to geneontology/go-ontology#29437. In summary: a minority belong on the new phagophore membrane term, a substantial block belong on phagophore assembly site instead (they record puncta of the Atg1/ULK scaffold, not a membrane), a further block belong on the new ATG9-containing vesicle term, and roughly a third have no localisation evidence in the cited paper at all (NAS annotations to complex-composition and genetic-redundancy papers, and four cases where the annotated gene is not a subject of the reference). Groups will want to read their own rows rather than accept a blanket redirect.

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule)

From `mappings_GO_0034045.tsv`:

- `uniprotkb_sl2go` - UniProtKB-SubCell:SL-0221 "Preautophagosomal structure membrane" > GO:0034045. This is the origin of most of the inferred volume on this term (GO_REF:0000044, and everything derived from it: GO_REF:0000104, GO_REF:0000107, GO_REF:0000117, GO_REF:0000118). SL-0221 is used heterogeneously in practice, and UniProt's own hierarchy places it partOf the endomembrane system rather than partOf SL-0220, so it should be reviewed rather than repointed wholesale.
- `unirule2go` - UniRule:UR000360759, UR000459774, UR000908760, UR001378758, UR001529790

Without this step the obsoleted term's annotation set regenerates on the next release.

----

Annotation extensions also reference this term, and are not covered by the counts above. From `extensions_GO_0034045.tsv`:

- IntAct, Atg5 (MGI:MGI:1277186) and Atg16l1 (MGI:MGI:1924290), PMID:12665549, protein binding, extension `GO:0034045|GO:0016020`
- UniProt, RAB33B (UniProtKB:Q9H082), PMID:32960676, G protein activity, extension `GO:0034497|GO:0034045`

These need repointing too. Both underlying papers are about targeting to the isolation membrane / phagophore, so phagophore membrane is the likely destination in all three cases, but that is for IntAct and UniProt to confirm.

Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:0034045 phagophore assembly site membrane
